Prevention: Colleting the crop residue after harvesting and remove from the field
Collecting the weeds at the end of the season to make sure the beetle does not live on other plants during the dormant period
Irrigating in winter and stand the water for many days to cool the field
Grow a thick cereal crop like wheat for example in the fields that were infested
Monitoring: Monitoring can be done once a week
Monitoring is done on the upper and down sides of the leaf, because adult and larva live on the upper side of the leaf and eggs are laid on down side of the leaf
A number of 20-30 eggs are laid on down side of the leaf
Control should be started when 10-15 larvae seen on one plant
Direct Control: Destroying of eggs which are laid on down side of the leaf.
Do not kill beneficial lady bird beetles as they often control potato
Using of imidacloprid (Confidor) 1-2 ml per litre of water
Deltamethrin 2 ml per litre of water
Restrictions: Use protective clothing when spraying to protect your eyes, mouth and skin
Buy chemicals from a certified dealer and keep them out of the reach of children
Do not eat, drink or smoke during the spray
Pesticide should be used on larval stage
Pesticide should be used on larval stage.
Spray the pesticide two times with an interval of 15 days.
Use alternate pesticide after use of one pesticide to minimise possible resistance
